verdict.rationale: Daytona has no first-party natural-language interface. Users can still drive it in natural language through external AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) via its official MCP server, and an agent skill teaches agents the API, CLI and SDK patterns. Its own documented interfaces (SDKs, CLI, web terminal) are programmatic or command-based, so natural-language operation depends on extra third-party tools. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documentation of which sandbox operations the MCP server exposes to natural-language control, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.
